sources.notes: Daily all-India tracker. Primary live reference for net collections and shows.

sources.notes: Trade desk with day-wise India net, gross and worldwide.

sources.name: Bollywood Hungama
sources.notes: Long-running Hindi trade tables. Often narrower (Hindi-weighted) than pan-India trackers.

sources.name: Box Office India
sources.notes: Classic trade weekly. Slower, conservative nett. Does not cover all South films equally.

sources.name: Pinkvilla
sources.notes: Newsroom estimates, usually India gross, citing trade.

sources.name: Indian Express
sources.notes: Reported figures attributed to Sacnilk and other trackers.

sources.name: ETimes
sources.notes: Times of India entertainment desk, language-wise splits on big openings.

sources.notes: Secondary compilation of published worldwide grosses. Lags live trade.

sources.name: Producer statement
sources.notes: Studio / producer claimed gross. Logged for spread, never used as sole consensus. No canonical URL.

films.title: Toxic

films.synopsis: A pan-India drama set in post-independence Goa. Dual-role Yash vehicle that opened like a mass film and is holding like a divided one.

films.title: Awarapan 2
films.synopsis: Vishesh Films sequel. Quiet Independence-weekend build, then a genuine word-of-mouth climb into the 100-crore club.

films.title: Vishwanath And Sons
films.synopsis: Suriya family drama with a slow theatrical burn. Producer gross and Sacnilk remain tens of crores apart — the year's clearest reporting gap.

films.title: Irumudi
films.synopsis: Ayyappa Deeksha road film that turned into Ravi Teja's cleanest family hold of the decade, led by Nizam.

films.title: Batwara 1947
films.synopsis: Partition drama that found a North circuit but not a national breakout.

films.title: Hi
films.synopsis: Small-to-mid Tamil release climbing on Sunday occupancy rather than a Friday blast.

films.title: Insidious: Out of The Further
films.synopsis: Horror holdover with a serviceable multiplex opening and a fast weekday fade.

films.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
films.synopsis: Kids' matinee title. Modest India gross, weekend-weighted.

films.title: Hanuman Ansh
films.synopsis: Devotional animation with a long thin tail rather than an opening.

films.title: Sardar 2
films.synopsis: Karthi's spy-action sequel opened in India on September 10, 2026.

films.title: Haiwaan
films.synopsis: Priyadarshan's Hindi thriller released in India on September 11, 2026.

films.title: Mirzapur: The Movie
films.starring: Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Divyenndu, Jitendra Kumar, Ravi Kishan
films.synopsis: The theatrical continuation of the Mirzapur crime saga.

films.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
films.synopsis: The year's biggest Hollywood grosser in India. Still occupying premium screens in week five.

films.title: Dhamaal 4
films.starring: Arshad Warsi, Javed Jaffrey, Riteish Deshmukh
films.synopsis: Comedy franchise that paid for itself without becoming a cultural event.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.starring: Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway
films.synopsis: Prestige Hollywood hold. India is a premium-screen story, not a mass one.

films.title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
films.starring: Ranveer Singh, Akshaye Khanna, R. Madhavan, Sanjay Dutt
films.synopsis: The film that bent 2026. Roughly a fifth of India's first-half box office sat in this one title.

films.title: Border 2
films.starring: Sunny Deol, Varun Dhawan, Diljit Dosanjh, Ahan Shetty
films.synopsis: Republic Day war film. Second-highest Indian grosser of the year, a long way behind Dhurandhar.

films.title: Peddi
films.synopsis: Sports drama whose worldwide gross is still published as a range — ₹330 to ₹400 crore.

films.title: Jana Nayagan
films.synopsis: Vijay's theatrical farewell. Tight 320–325 crore band across newsrooms, now on ZEE5.

films.title: Karuppu
films.synopsis: Suriya's mass register. Paired with Vishwanath And Sons, his most complete year.

films.title: Mana Shankara Vara Prasad Garu
films.synopsis: Sankranti Megastar film. Solid 300-crore worldwide without dominating the year.

films.title: Bhooth Bangla
films.synopsis: Comedy-horror that landed as a paid-up performer rather than a runaway.

films.title: Drishyam 3: The Conclusion
films.starring: Ajay Devgn, Tabu, Shriya Saran, Jaideep Ahlawat
films.synopsis: Hindi theatrical conclusion of the Drishyam franchise — Day 1 India nett crossed ₹60 Cr.

films.title: Vaazha II: Biopic of a Billion Bros
films.synopsis: Sequel that out-earned its scale. A Mollywood word-of-mouth case study.

films.title: Welcome To The Jungle
films.synopsis: Early-summer comedy that held a multiplex floor into July.

films.title: Cocktail 2
films.starring: Saif Ali Khan, Deepika Padukone, Diana Penty
films.synopsis: Nostalgia sequel. Average verdict, adult multiplex.

films.title: Alpha
films.synopsis: YRF spy-verse entry that opened and then fell off a cliff.
